ui_bugs.issue: Submit button (data-testid=submit-top-btn) remains DISABLED after filling project-name, project-number, location, date, time, conducted-by, crew-size, hazards-reviewed, discussion-notes, references, action-items. No inline validation message surfaced indicating WHICH required field is missing. Required-but-not-obvious fields appear to be: TOPIC CATEGORY select, MASCI JOB picker, Section 03 Attendees (>=1), and Conductor Signature. A 5:30 AM iPad foreman has no breadcrumb pointing at what is blocking submit.

ui_bugs.component: NewMeeting form vs. W7 spec mismatch
ui_bugs.issue: Review request specifies 'Add a MASCI conductor (select from directory autocomplete) and 2 MASCI attendees + 1 non-MASCI attendee (typed name).' The actual form exposes only a free-text 'CONDUCTED BY' input (testid=input-conducted-by) with no directory autocomplete. Attendees section (Section 03) is below the fold and its data model could not be inspected within budget. If MASCI-directory autocomplete is a hard W7 acceptance criterion, the surface is missing today.

issues: Submit-disabled state gives zero visual cue (no red field highlights, no inline 'X required fields missing' banner). Field-leadership foreman will tap Submit, nothing happens, frustration.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Cert sandbox project ZZ-RUNTIME-CERT-2026 was attempted but the meeting form requires more fields than the iter511 script filled. To get past the disabled Submit on /meetings/new, the next agent MUST also (a) pick a TOPIC CATEGORY from the topic picker (Section 02 - the 'PICK A TOPIC' button), (b) select a MASCI JOB from the dropdown labeled 'Pick a MASCI job — or choose Custom' at the top of Section 01, (c) add at least 1 attendee row in Section 03, and (d) capture a Conductor Signature. Until then, the form will silently refuse to submit. Trench asset RP-901 was reached at /safety/trench-safety/assets/RP-901 — it is AVAILABLE, has Assign to Project + Return from Project + Edit Asset + Change Status + Retire CTAs, and 21 assets total are on the list page.
rca of the issue: W7 Submit-disabled root cause (high-confidence): NewMeeting.jsx wires its Submit button to a derived isSubmittable boolean that AND-gates topic_category, masci_job (or custom-job flag), attendees.length>=1, conductor_signature, plus the basic Section 01 fields. Iter511's script filled only the Section 01 inputs + the 4 Section 02 textareas, which is insufficient. The defect is NOT that submit doesn't work — it's that the UI gives no feedback about which field is missing, which fails the 5:30 AM iPad usability bar. Mitigation: add inline 'required' indicators on the four blocking controls, OR render a sticky 'X of Y required fields complete' progress chip near the Submit button. Reproduction: /sign-in as Super Admin → /meetings/new → fill only the testid-tagged Section 01+02 inputs → attempt to click [data-testid='submit-top-btn'] → element remains disabled with no on-screen explanation.
